name: stackengine
description: Zero-Trust Remediation Engine for Cloud-Native Ops. Client-side WASM engine that locally redacts secrets before LLM exposure.

scripts.build: npm run bundle:wasm && tsup src/cli.ts --format esm --out-dir dist --clean --minify
scripts.build:bin: npm run bundle:wasm && bun build --compile ./src/cli.ts --outfile dist/stackengine
scripts.prepack: npm run build && copyfiles -u 1 public/wasm/**/* dist/
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test:windtunnel && npm run build

author: StackEngine <contact@stackengine.dev> (https://stackengine.dev)
